title: EventBus callback remove-then-reregister different-callback recovery contract

contract.remove_then_reregister_different_callbac: A callback can remove another listener and re-register the same owner with a different callback during an active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.current_cycle_delivery_continuity: The original listener receives the active broadcast exactly once before mutation completes
contract.replacement_callback_current_cycle_isola: The replacement callback registered during the active broadcast does not receive the same broadcast a second time
contract.replacement_callback_activation: The replacement callback becomes active for subsequent broadcasts
contract.duplicate_owner_prevention: Re-registration restores exactly one listener entry for the owner
contract.registry_order_integrity: A removed and re-registered listener is appended as a new registry position
contract.old_callback_isolation: The removed callback receives no subsequent broadcasts
contract.post_mutation_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every currently registered listener
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after callback-driven remove-then-reregister mutation
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
